Meeting Finder

Product·by @jeetnirnejak·2026-08-26·inspora page·original post

What it is

Meeting Finder timezone widget: 4 city rows (San Francisco, New York, Sao Paulo, London), each a strip of colored hour-blocks across 24h; a draggable vertical scrubber sweeps the strips, highlighting the covered blocks and live-updating a status line ('1 of 4 in working hours' -> green 'Works for everyone'); 'Find best time' auto-snaps the scrubber to the optimal overlap.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-20%
Card 'Meeting Finder': rows of rounded hour-blocks per city, blocks colored by working-hours quality (blue, purple, magenta/pink, yellow) over a faint grey grid; scrubber parked mid-morning; status 'Off hours everywhere'; local times listed right.
20-45%
Scrubber drags right: blocks under it lift/highlight with a white ring; per-city local time labels update; status flips to '1 of 4 in working hours'.
45-65%
Scrubber near evening: '3 of 4, late in London'; block colors under the line brighten; a small tooltip clock rides the scrubber top.
65-85%
Sweep back left past midnight: 'Off hours everywhere' again; scrubber handle is a slim white rounded bar with a grip notch.
85-100%
'Find best time' clicked: scrubber animates by itself to the max-overlap slot, blocks for all four cities light, status turns green: 'Works for everyone'.

Build prompt

Build a timezone meeting finder. Card 420px, white, radius 16, 'Meeting Finder' header + UTC clock top-right. Rows: one per city (dot in city color, name, UTC offset), each a strip of 24 rounded 10px hour-blocks on a faint grid; block fill encodes that hour's working-hours quality for the city (blue = work, purple = evening, pink = late, yellow = early morning, grey = asleep). A vertical scrubber - 3px white bar with a rounded grip and a tiny clock tooltip - spans all rows; drag it (pointer events, clamped, snapping to 15-min) and every block it crosses gets a 2px white ring + 20% brightness lift; right-side labels render each city's local time at the scrubber. Status line bottom-left computes overlap: 'Off hours everywhere' (muted), 'N of 4 in working hours', 'N of 4, late in X', and green 'Works for everyone' when all rows are in work blocks - text swaps with a 150ms fade. 'Find best time' (black pill, bottom-right) animates the scrubber 600ms ease-in-out to the widest all-working overlap and lands the status green.
